svg.desc: What each kind of endpoint lets a client measure. Columns: weights in the book's code, a local server, open weights via a router, a closed model via a router. Rows: weights and activations; prompt log-probabilities; generated-token log-probabilities; rendered prompt and chat template; sampler beyond temperature and top-p; seed and batching control; token counts from usage; structured output; many samples. Filled circles mark available, half circles depends on the provider or server, open circles withheld by the protocol.
